boards.title: Focus
boards.detail:
Board title "FOCUS / POMO PLACEMENT". Labels F1 to F5.
Each large square widget must retain the CURRENT native layout: at the top a huge bold red "18:42" on the left and a text stack on the right reading "Design review", "Focus", "2 / 4". An airy middle/lower section. At the bottom the small gray line "Next: Short break", then a thin red/gray horizontal progress line along the full bottom. No timer ring and no pause button.
F1: thinking Pomo fully visible in the lower-right empty area, looking toward the timer.
F2: calm Pomo fully visible in the lower-left empty area.
F3: a small happy Pomo centered in the lower empty area, just above the next-break footer.
F4: thinking Pomo gently peeking from the right edge in the lower half, leaf/body partially cropped but face clear.
F5: calm Pomo sitting/settled toward the lower center-right, comfortable quiet pose and a little more white space around it.
These are placements within the same existing widget, NOT five different styles.
boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, reference-guided compositing.
Create one polished comparison board showing FIVE alternative large Apple systemLarge Pomodoist widgets, all in the EXISTING Quiet Typography visual style.
Image 1 is the authoritative UI style reference, NOT a layout to copy as a whole board: use only its white rounded native widgets, SF-like clean system sans typography, bold tabular red digits #D83B2E, dark charcoal text, muted gray secondary labels, hairline dividers. Do NOT use its small/accessory/Watch/Live Activity shapes. Images 2,3,4 are authoritative Pomo identity references (thinking, happy, calm). Pomo must remain this exact recognizable cute red 3D tomato character with green leafy hair, big dark eyes, red mitten hands and feet, soft matte shading. Keep full color, same silhouette and proportions; no redesign or costumes, no extra props.
Board format: landscape 3:2, ideally 1800x1200 or greater. Exactly FIVE equally sized LARGE NEAR-SQUARE widget faces, like 338x354pt systemLarge widgets, arranged 3 across top and 2 across bottom, aligned in a clean spacious grid. Each widget fully visible, no phone/watch frames, no compact adaptations. Pale neutral board background, understated outer labels and one short board title. Cards all solid white, large rounded corners, minimal soft native shadow. Render all five widgets at the exact same scale. Labels outside widgets, not inside data area.
PRIMARY REQUEST: ONLY add Pomo into the existing otherwise empty lower or side region of the large widget. Preserve the original information architecture, content, typography, color, and flat surfaces across all five. Avoid gradients, glass, neon, skeuomorphic dials, extra rings, invented metrics, buttons, decorative confetti or scenery. Pomo is a secondary companion, about 22–30 percent of the widget height, grounded with a very soft contact shadow. Vary pose and placement, not UI theme. Keep every digit, task title, checkbox, chart and label unobstructed; no mascot overlap with content. Maintain visual calm and breathing room. All five share identical data. Crisp legible text. No watermark.

boards.title: Tasks
boards.detail:
Board title "TASKS / POMO PLACEMENT". Labels T1 to T5.
Each large square widget preserves the current layout: upper-left thin red outlined circular checkbox followed by a bold black "Design review" heading; a thin divider below; small gray "NEXT"; two black text rows "Send proposal" and "Plan launch". Do not strike through incomplete tasks. Leave the current generous unused lower region below the list. No new task list, no new stats, no checkmarks replacing the active checkbox.
T1: thinking Pomo fully visible in the empty lower-right corner, looking up at the list.
T2: calm Pomo fully visible lower-left, the completed layout remains identical.
T3: small happy Pomo centered along the bottom edge.
T4: curious thinking Pomo peeks in from the lower-right side edge, face unobstructed.
T5: small standing happy Pomo in the lower-left-to-center blank area, relaxed welcoming hands.
Pomo never covers, replaces or holds any task UI.

boards.title: Day plan

Board title "DAY PLAN / POMO PLACEMENT". Labels D1 to D5.
Each large square widget preserves CURRENT native agenda layout at the top: bold black "Wed, Oct 28", below three rows with gray times on the left, short thin red vertical rules, and black titles: "09:30  Design review", "11:00  Send proposal", "14:00  Plan launch". D1: thinking Pomo in the empty lower-right corner, attentive expression.
